name: jarvis
description: Jarvis: a personal chief of staff that cuts communication overload for engineers and engineering managers, and learns who and what matters to you.

plugins.name: jarvis
plugins.description: One main skill (jarvis) that triages Outlook + Teams into a ranked brief of what needs you and drafts in your voice, plus an auxiliary curator (jarvis-tune) that keeps its learned memory accurate. Runs interactively and unattended as a scheduled Workflow. Draft-only by default.
